}}Master '''Fitch''' is the innkeeper of the [[Stag and Lion]] in [[Baerlon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Fitch, Master}}

== Appearance ==
He is a rotund, good-natured man.

== Activities ==
Because he thinks very highly of "[[Moiraine Damodred|Mistress Alys]]" and "[[Lan Mandragoran|Master Andra]]," he finds room for them and the [[Emond's Field]]ers in his crowded inn, making sure that they are refreshed and well-fed.

After a [[Fade]] attacks [[Rand]] at night, necessitating their departure from the inn, Lan and Moiraine urge Fitch to be open with potential troublemakers and clearly show his disassociation with their party, but he stubbornly insists on protecting their privacy and honor. His principles lead to his inn being torched, presumably by the [[Whitecloaks]], who are rife in Baerlon at the time, but it could also have been [[darkfriends]].{{ref/book|1|17}} Moiraine later organizes compensation so that he might rebuild.
